name: checkbox
title: Checkbox, radio and switch
description: Themed checkbox, radio and on/off switch, each with its label in one clickable row.
whenToUse: Checkbox for independent options and table row selection; radio for one choice out of a few; switch for a setting that applies at once.

variants.description: Vertical or horizontal group with a legend.

a11y: Use native inputs inside a <label>. Group radios in a <fieldset> with a <legend>. A switch is <input type="checkbox" role="switch">.
